s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic fingernail changes with subungual lesions and discharge, accompanied by scalp lesions
salient_findings: Subungual purpuric lesions
Yellowish discharge from the left thumbnail
Friable tumor with purulent discharge under the left thumbnail
Subungual hemorrhages affecting most fingernails
Erythematous, scaly papules with crusts on the scalp
key_facts: 11-month history of changes in most fingernails
Initial presentation of subungual purpuric lesions
Yellowish discharge from the left thumbnail weeks after initial presentation
Partial improvement with antibiotic treatment
Recurrence and worsening of the lesion
Friable tumor with purulent discharge under the left thumbnail
Subungual hemorrhages affecting most fingernails
Scalp lesions previously diagnosed as seborrheic dermatitis
Biopsies from the nail bed lesion and scalp papules showed a diffuse infiltrate in the upper dermis
Medium-to-large mononuclear cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and reniform nuclei
Inflammatory cells admixed with mononuclear cells
Immunohistochemical analysis demonstrated positivity for CD1a and S100 protein
Negativity for CD68
Testing for the BRAF V600E mutation was negative

shortlist.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Immunohistochemical analysis demonstrated positivity for CD1a and S100 protein, consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis

shortlist.label: Indeterminate cell histiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: Medium-to-large mononuclear cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and reniform nuclei, similar to indeterminate cell histiocytosis

shortlist.label: Erdheim-Chester disease
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse infiltrate in the upper dermis with medium-to-large mononuclear cells, consistent with Erdheim-Chester disease

shortlist.label: Rosai-Dorfman disease
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of medium-to-large mononuclear cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, similar to Rosai-Dorfman disease

shortlist.label: Juvenile xanthogranuloma
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation of subungual lesions and scalp lesions, consistent with juvenile xanthogranuloma
